title: PlanRecordedV1
description: Agent to gateway on agent-events.fifo: the plan for a real incident's fix, made once per investigation after a live triage's real verdict, for a human to approve or reject. Nothing runs from it. Sent once after the transaction that stored it; MessageGroupId is the investigation id, so it follows the investigation's ReportRecorded, and MessageDeduplicationId plan-<investigation_id>.

plan_id.description: The plan's id, which a human's decision names.

plan.description: The plan; null when no model gave one that passed the agent's checks, and problem says why.

problem.description: Why there is no plan, such as every model failing or the agent's check refusing the plan given; null when there is one.

models.description: Every model asked for the plan, in the order first asked.

failed.description: Requests it did not answer or answered with no plan, and requests the agent skipped before they reached it.

reason.description: Why the last of those failed or was skipped; null when it answered every request.

kind.description: none: no fixed action fits, and the rationale says what a human should do; restart_service: restart one app or worker container of the app (run from phase 3 on); code_fix: change the app's source on a local branch (phase 4).

target.description: A service of the app's catalog: the one to restart, the one whose code changes, or for none the one at fault.

files.description: code_fix only: the repo paths to change, each in the app's source allowlist; empty for the other kinds.

rationale.description: The plan's only free text: the cause, the evidence it rests on, what the plan changes and how a human checks it worked.

plan.rationale: The worker container exited with 137 at 09:51 while postgres, redis, minio and the egress proxy stay healthy [tc_01J9ZK3Q7M]. Restart it, then check that it stays up and the queue drains.

examples.problem: No model gave a plan: gemini-3.5-flash-lite: RateLimited: gemini 429: rate limited
